what_this_is: The decision layer of the full review packet, published separately so a reader can decide whether this is relevant to them without downloading 14 MB of evidence first.
authority: Projection only. Every field here is copied verbatim from plectis-ai-review-packet.json after that file's gates have run. Where the two disagree, the packet is right and this is stale -- regenerate rather than editing this file.

project_thesis.role: the one paragraph a reader should get before any inventory

problem.statement: Agent-assisted work can be produced faster than anyone can check it. The bottleneck moves from writing the change to establishing that the change is what its author says it is.

mechanism.statement: Route every claim to the thing that would settle it: the source it came from, the command that produces its verdict, the receipt that run left, and the sentence saying where its authority stops.

public_evidence.statement: 88 components, of which 20 invoke external machinery from the published artifact.
One component runs real git and pytest against planted false completion claims and names each refusal in its receipt.
4 defects the project's own checks found and published against its own sources, with what to do until each is fixed.
Work on 8 open Erdos problems, none of them solved here, with each statement quoted at the strength its registry asserts.

boundary.statement: The public slice can be checked. It does not establish that the unpublished system is reliable, that any of this works outside its fixtures, or that it is ready to be used by anyone else.

what_the_author_wants.statement: Assurance rather than attention: a way to find out whether any of this survives contact with someone who knows the field, including the answer that it does not.

signature_evidence_sets.selection_rule: Chosen for explanatory coverage, not for being the strongest rows. Every set carries at least one command that runs external machinery, at least one negative case or published defect, and every record states where its authority stops.
signature_evidence_sets.why_not_more: Three records is the point at which a reader can still hold the whole set in mind. The other components are not hidden; they are in component_digest, all 88 of them.

general_first_pass.for: any reader deciding whether this is technically real
general_first_pass.why_these: One mechanism that runs external tools and refuses planted false claims; one that catches a generated file disagreeing with its source; and one defect the project published against itself. Strength, the check that constrains strength, and a failure.

records.label: Agent Completion Faithfulness Audit
records.why_chosen: the shortest path from a claim to a refusal: real git and pytest calls against planted forgeries, with the refusals named in the receipt
records.what_it_shows: Runs real git and pytest on a sample repo so wrap-up claims state only what the evidence proves.
records.scope_limit: verified means the referenced evidence object exists or a pytest span ran; it does not imply the span passed unless exit-zero status was explicitly checked

records.label: Generated Projection Drift Runtime
records.why_chosen: the rule the rest of the project rests on -- a generated file may not disagree with the source it came from -- as a runnable check rather than a stated principle
records.what_it_shows: Runs each owner's own drift check on generated files and flags repairs, without changing the file.
records.scope_limit: The bundle demonstrates owner-routed generated projection drift detection over declared artifacts, source authorities, clean-result record fingerprints, and no-write check return codes. It is not semantic drift proof, not full source registry validation, not repair authority, and not launch-scope decision.

This matters more since the packet began routing novelty questions to the prior-art posture: a reader following a posture that names an antecedent now arrives at a row they cannot follow.
records.scope_limit: Treat an unlocated antecedent as unverified positioning. The claim it concerns is unaffected; what is missing is the route to the prior work.

reviewer_diligence_ladder.rule: Every rung names what it settles and what it does not. A reader who stops at any rung has a defensible position, not a partial one.

controlled_review_protocol.why_this_exists: The open question the author cannot answer alone is whether the unpublished work survives expert contact. Asking for a general look at a private system is not a request anyone can accept, so this is the same request made answerable: one fixed claim, the least access that could test it, terms stated first.

access_levels.name: public packet review
access_levels.access: nothing beyond this file and the public repositories
access_levels.answers: whether the public claims hold together

access_levels.name: source-assisted public review
access_levels.access: the same, with the author available to answer questions
access_levels.answers: whether a reviewer's own route through the public material lands where the packet says

access_levels.name: redacted demonstration
access_levels.access: recorded outputs for a fixed claim; no source transferred
access_levels.answers: whether a named behaviour occurs, without establishing how

access_levels.name: scoped confidential source review
access_levels.access: named modules only, fixed configuration, stated retention
access_levels.answers: whether one claim is supported by the code that implements it

access_levels.name: wider review
access_levels.access: considered only if a lower level produced a finding that needs it
access_levels.answers: nothing by itself; it is an escalation, not a certification

controlled_review_protocol.the_asymmetry_that_makes_it_safe: The reviewer chooses the cases and keeps the right to report what they found. The author keeps release responsibility and gains no authority to describe the outcome as validation.

evidence_gap_register.why_this_exists: This project has far stronger evidence that its mechanisms exist and repeat than that they matter. Leaving a reader to discover that themselves invites them to read it as concealment; stating it makes the next experiment obvious.

rungs.means: the mechanism is described and its source is public
its own command reproduces the result from a public fixture
someone unconnected to the author ran it and reported what happened
it ran against real work, not a fixture, and the outcome was measured
the result held under a different agent harness or model family
a team's review cost or error rate changed measurably
it kept working over time under conditions the author did not choose

why_it_stops_there.statement: The rung above requires someone unconnected to the author. The cold rerun published on the landing page is author-run and says so in the sentence that reports it passing.
